parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records live in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork), which is a test file. Under the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-resident record must be treated as a test-fixture no-action. The two CGImage extensions at lines 61 and 91 of ArtworkServiceTests.swift are test helpers; consolidating them with the production Image extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift' would couple production Core code to test semantics. The two Image extensions in ImageCompatability.swift (lines 19 and 88) may themselves warrant internal consolidation, but that is a separate, single-package concern not surfaced by this cross-package cluster.
